summary_en: This Phase 1/Phase 2 trial tests external beam radiation therapy and brachytherapy with cisplatin and paclitaxel chemotherapy and pembrolizumab and bevacizumab immunotherapy for stage IVB cervical cancer. Part 1 gives cisplatin, paclitaxel, pembrolizumab, and bevacizumab through an IV every 21 days for 6 cycles, followed by 3 weeks with no treatment; Part 2 gives external beam radiation for 25 treatments over 5 weeks, brachytherapy over 3 to 5 treatments, and pembrolizumab and bevacizumab through an IV every 21 days for a total of 2 years. The record does not state a specific main outcome measure; the study is described as testing safety and effectiveness.
summary_es: Este ensayo de fase 1/fase 2 evalúa la radioterapia de haz externo y la braquiterapia junto con quimioterapia con cisplatino y paclitaxel e inmunoterapia con pembrolizumab y bevacizumab para el cáncer de cuello uterino en estadio IVB. La parte 1 administra cisplatino, paclitaxel, pembrolizumab y bevacizumab por vía intravenosa cada 21 días durante 6 ciclos, seguidos de 3 semanas sin tratamiento; la parte 2 administra radioterapia de haz externo en 25 sesiones durante 5 semanas, braquiterapia en 3 a 5 sesiones, y pembrolizumab y bevacizumab por vía intravenosa cada 21 días durante un total de 2 años. El registro no indica un resultado principal específico; el estudio se describe como una prueba de la seguridad y la eficacia.
who_for: At least 18 years old on the day consent is signed
Newly diagnosed stage IVB adenocarcinoma, adenosquamous carcinoma, or squamous cell carcinoma of the cervix, not yet treated with chemotherapy or radiation
Has measurable disease by RECIST 1.1 criteria
not_for: Prior anti-PD-1, anti-PD-L1, anti-PD-L2, or similar T-cell checkpoint agent
Hepatitis B (HBsAg reactive) or active hepatitis C infection
Active autoimmune disease that needed systemic treatment in the past 2 years
